code: error = ofpacts_pull_openflow_actions(&b, ntohs(opo->actions_len), oh->version, NULL, NULL, ofpacts);
note: The packet-out actions_len field from the input controls how many bytes are decoded as OpenFlow actions.

code: error = ofpacts_decode(actions, actions_len, version, vl_mff_map, ofpacts_tlv_bitmap, ofpacts);
note: The input-controlled action bytes are passed into the action decoder with the current ofpacts output buffer.

code: error = ofpact_decode(action, raw, ofp_version, arg, vl_mff_map, ofpacts_tlv_bitmap, ofpacts);
note: The decoded raw action type selects the NXAST_ENCAP decoder while retaining the same ofpacts buffer.
An ENCAP ofpact is appended to out and encap points into the current out allocation.
The input action length leaves multiple property TLVs for the decoder loop to append after the ENCAP header.
decode_ed_prop appends to out and may reallocate it, so the safety obligation is that encap must still designate the current out object before any later write.
Each NSH md_type property appends bytes to out; enough properties exhaust the initial 64-byte ofpbuf allocation and reallocate it.
After a reallocation, encap still points into freed storage and this write stores the property count through the stale pointer.
